# AgentArmor — Head-to-head Comparison

**Results as of: AgentArmor v1.4.0, run 2026-04-19**

This document compares AgentArmor against two established safety classifiers — LlamaGuard 3 (local, Q4_K_M via llama-cpp-python) and OpenAI Moderation (omni-moderation-latest) — across six industry datasets with per-sample verdicts and bootstrap confidence intervals. Perspective API was considered but excluded from v1: Google/Jigsaw announced sunset with API EOL 2026-12-31, which would leave any published comparison non-reproducible within months. We publish per-dataset numbers only: no overall-winner claim, and we annotate every cell where AgentArmor loses or ties within CI. Reproduction: set `OPENAI_API_KEY` and run `python -m benchmarks.run_head_to_head --run-dir benchmarks/results/runs/<ts>` (see [`RUNBOOK.md`](RUNBOOK.md) Procedure 0).

| --- | --- |

| `agentarmor_ml_shield` | AgentArmor ML shield τ=0.65 (our shipping default) |
| `agentarmor_shield` | AgentArmor regex shield (bool; no PR curve — regex-by-design) |
| `agentarmor_toxicity` | AgentArmor toxicity filter at shipping config |
| `llamaguard` | P("unsafe") from Q4_K_M first-token logprobs (our quantization choice) |
| `openai_moderation` | max over per-dataset category projection (see rubric) |

## Appendices

### PR curves (appendix)

Precision–recall curves are rendered only for score-emitting `(baseline, dataset)` pairs on the six main-comparison datasets, and only when at least 50 positive samples are present (below that, bootstrap PR is too noisy to publish honestly — SPEC v4 D12).

**Why a PR curve is missing (D48):**

- `shield` (regex; bool-by-design, no curve)
- `exfiltration_guard` (regex; bool-by-design, no curve)
- `unicode_shield` (regex; bool-by-design, no curve)
- `llamaguard` (when the logprobs gate fell back to text-parse — cell scores 0/1 only; see D36 and TYPE_WALKTHROUGH.md V1)
- Cells with fewer than 50 positives (noise floor)

_Curves are not yet rendered in this preview; the schema retains the per-sample `pred_score` needed to generate them from `head_to_head_verdicts.jsonl`._

### Cells marked `does_not_apply`

The applicability rubric (`benchmarks/taxonomy_applicability.py`) declares a (baseline, dataset) pair inapplicable when the baseline's taxonomy does not meaningfully overlap the dataset's labeling construct. Those cells are omitted from the comparison tables above.

| Baseline | Dataset | Rationale |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `perspective` | `advbench` | Perspective API sunset + taxonomic mismatch with adversarial jailbreaks. |
| `perspective` | `harmbench` | Perspective API sunset + taxonomic mismatch (toxicity != harmful-behavior elicitation). |
| `perspective` | `jailbreakbench` | Perspective API sunset + taxonomic mismatch (jailbreak prompts rarely toxic in surface form). |
| `perspective` | `realtoxicity` | Perspective API sunset (see sibling entries). Historical Perspective/RTP numbers are documented in the original Perspective papers; we did not attempt to replicate them against a dying API. |
| `perspective` | `toxigen` | Perspective API sunset (see sibling entries). |
| `perspective` | `xstest` | Perspective API is being sunset by Google/Jigsaw (no new requests after Feb 2026; API EOL 2026-12-31). Excluded from v1 to keep the comparison reproducible beyond the sunset date. |

### Methodology notes

- **Bootstrap F1 CI:** 5000 iterations, per-cell seed derived from `sha256(baseline|dataset)` (SPEC v4 D44/D45). `random.Random`, not numpy — survives minor-version bumps across the pinned `numpy<2.0`.
- **Per-metric degenerate guards (D41):** F1, MCC, and balanced-accuracy each have distinct zero-denominator conditions; cells flagged "insufficient data for CI" (`degenerate_flag=true`) report the point estimate alone.
- **Reproducibility tolerances (D16/D39):** `same_day_spread_95p` and `one_week_drift_max` are published once the calibration runs complete — see RUNBOOK.md for the procedure.
- **Hashes, not bodies (D49):** per-sample JSONL carries `raw_response: null` in committed artifacts. Use `--keep-raw-responses` for local debug only.
- **Live document:** this URL always reflects the latest tag. External links citing a specific version should pin by `git tag` (see Historical versions below).

### Historical versions

Each published version is an immutable git tag. To cite a specific version in blog posts or external links, use `https://github.com/<org>/AgentArmor/blob/<tag>/BENCHMARKS_HEAD_TO_HEAD.md`.
